bridgeRouteRisk.summary: AZND uses a two-contract LayerZero V2 external-lock-mint route: Monad AZNDOFTAdapter 0x7b2cba10e42e33c0a91b3216f0529eacc88392a2 locks and unlocks canonical AZND, while the Ethereum UUPS OFT 0x52c66b5e7f8fde20843de900c5c8b4b0f23708a0 burns on outbound transfer and mints on inbound credit. LayerZero V2 trusted peers connect the adapter and OFT. The route is supply-conserving only against the adapter's escrowed canonical AZND; Ethereum destination mint remains arbitrary bridge-credit risk if peer, Endpoint, or upgrade controls fail. Fixed-block ULN302 reads show 15 confirmations on Ethereum and 4 on Monad, with 3 required DVNs plus 1-of-2 optional DVNs in both directions, supporting the external-validated-network tier.

routes.protocol: LayerZero V2 OFT + OFT Adapter (MU Digital AZND)
routes.reviewNote: Verified at Ethereum block 25770630 (UTC 2026-08-16 22:30:47): the AZND UUPS OFT proxy 0x52c66b5e7f8fde20843de900c5c8b4b0f23708a0 resolves to implementation 0x2e49c14a73210356de9f23a46a98de777b8a0db6 and EndpointV2 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c. Its _debit burns on outbound transfer and _credit mints on inbound transfer; owner() is 0x8b5f269f68d42490dee19fc4ab275cdd80940068, accessManager() is 0xe683fcd4411dde6fc2be16c2512f9109c907b520, paused() is false, and peers(30390) is Monad AZNDOFTAdapter 0x7b2cba10e42e33c0a91b3216f0529eacc88392a2. The paired Monad adapter locks and unlocks canonical AZND, so the external-lock-mint route is supply-conserving only against that escrow; the adapter is the canonical-side lockbox controller for the route.

Canonical AZND on Monad (verified at block 96611302, UTC 2026-08-16 22:39:43): token 0x4917a5ec9fcb5e10f47cbb197abe6ab63be81fe8 has no LayerZero endpoint surface and native minting runs through PrimaryMarket 0xe64730de04aeaf8d38925825d77d7a4c00340c89 under the MU Digital AccessManager. Separate canonical-side bridge machinery, AZNDOFTAdapter 0x7b2cba10e42e33c0a91b3216f0529eacc88392a2, locks and unlocks this token and is not an additional native issuance deployment.

controls.label: AZND Ethereum OFT Mu Digital admin

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At Ethereum block 25770630, the OFT owner was 0x8b5f269f...0068 and peers(30390) returned Monad AZNDOFTAdapter 0x7b2cba10...392a. The OFT owner can replace the trusted peer; the paired adapter peer at Monad EID 30101 is recorded in the canonical-side bridge control.
routeChecks.rateLimits: No bridge rate-limit module was exposed by the verified Ethereum OFT ABI or source; no aggregate or per-route mint ceiling was evidenced.
routeChecks.caps: The Ethereum OFT burns on outbound _debit and mints inbound _credit without a token-level amount cap. Route conservation depends on the Monad adapter's escrowed canonical AZND rather than an Ethereum native-issuance cap.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At Ethereum block 25770630, paused() was false, the OFT implementation was 0x2e49c14a...0db6, accessManager() was 0xe683fcd4...b520, and that AccessManager's default admin was the same Mu Digital EOA. The OFT owner governs peer and application configuration; the AccessManager default-admin path governs UUPS replacement. No Safe or timelock was evidenced.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: At Ethereum block 25770630, the representation totalSupply was 15,911,609.410255 AZND. The paired Monad adapter held the same 15,911,609.410255 AZND at Monad block 96611302; this is a lock-backed route slice, not independent native issuance.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770630, AZND proxy owner() returned 0x8b5f269f...0068, accessManager() returned 0xe683fcd4...b520, the EIP-1967 implementation was 0x2e49c14a...0db6, paused() was false, and peers(30390) returned Monad AZNDOFTAdapter 0x7b2cba10...392a. The verified OFT source burns on outbound _debit and mints on inbound _credit; the owner can change peers and the AccessManager default admin can authorize UUPS replacement. The shared EOA therefore controls the Ethereum representation's bridge mint/burn, pause, peer, admin, and upgrade surfaces. The adapter, Monad AccessManager, shared-EOA common mode, and the route's fixed Endpoint/DVN observations remain recorded in the companion Bridge Risk controls.

controls.label: AZND Monad OFT Adapter Mu Digital admin and escrow

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At Monad block 96611302, AZNDOFTAdapter owner() returned 0x8b5f269f...0068, accessManager() returned 0x7b14860e...b47f, and peers(30101) returned Ethereum OFT 0x52c66b5e...08a0. The adapter owner can replace the trusted peer and its AccessManager default admin is the same Mu Digital EOA.
routeChecks.rateLimits: No bridge rate-limit module was exposed by the verified AZNDOFTAdapter ABI or source. approvalRequired() was true and decimalConversionRate() was 1,000,000,000,000.
routeChecks.caps: The adapter is a lockbox for canonical AZND and has no independently evidenced aggregate amount cap. It locks canonical AZND on outbound transfer and unlocks it on inbound transfer; arbitrary excess credit would require a peer, Endpoint, or implementation failure elsewhere in the route.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At Monad block 96611302, paused() was false, the adapter implementation was 0x2288832c...bb14d, and its AccessManager implementation was 0xef1776ed...5461. The shared Mu Digital EOA owns the adapter and is its AccessManager default admin; no Safe or timelock was evidenced.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: At Monad block 96611302, canonical AZND totalSupply was 16,326,375.99 and the adapter escrow balance was 15,911,609.410255 AZND. The Ethereum representation totalSupply was 15,911,609.410255 at block 25770630, supporting conservation for the locked slice only.
